Marie: quick Q — running into a case where the prefetcher batch job shows only a single root span in Jaeger for a request (req_id=pf-abc123). No child spans (DB, kvcache) are visible. Where should I look first for missing spans / sampling issues?

Aditya: start with Traces -> Services -> prefetcher in the observability console, filter by Trace ID or request id. Also check the OTEL collector config and the SDK sampler on the service — we've bitten by sampler fallthrough before. Typical checklist:
- kubectl logs for the pod to confirm request id flows to logs (`kubectl logs -n prod deploy/prefetcher | rg pf-abc123`)
- Trace search by trace id in Jaeger: https://jaeger.internal/traces?traceID=pf-abc123
- Check collector pipelines: repo infra/observability/otel/collector.yaml for `probabilistic_sampler` or `parentbased` settings

Rachel: two quick gotchas we've seen: 1) context not propagated across our internal gRPC wrapper (missing interceptor), and 2) SDK initialized after the client is created so spans are no-op. If it's Go, ensure you call `otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)` before creating clients.

Ben: for logs + config pointers:
```
# find pod with recent restarts and tail logs
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=prefetcher
kubectl -n prod logs pod/prefetcher-xxxxx -c prefetcher --since=1h | rg pf-abc123
```
Also grep for `traceparent` header in ingress logs — if the header is dropped at the edge we only see root spans.

oncall-bot: [incident] New trace-alert: trace-orphans-prefetcher triggered for service prefetcher (threshold: 0.5% orphan spans)

Marie: thanks — I can see the root span in Jaeger UI but child spans are missing. I grabbed the pod logs and see `otel: sampler fallthrough` message in startup logs. Not sure where that config came from.

Aditya: that `sampler fallthrough` sounds like Collector's `parentbased` fallback to `always_off` in a misconfigured pipeline. Check the collector deployment env var `OTEL_SAMPLER_ARG` and the configmap `otel-collector-config`. Also check the SDK initialization snippet in the prefetcher repo (services/prefetcher/cmd/main.go). If sampler is set low, child spans might be dropped at the SDK level.

Rachel: if you need a quick local repro, set the tracer provider to always_on temporarily and restart one replica to confirm child spans appear:
```go
// example Go snippet in main.go
tp := sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(
  sdktrace.WithSampler(sdktrace.AlwaysSample()),
)
otel.SetTracerProvider(tp)
// then create clients/servers after this
```
Make sure to roll back sampling rate change after debug — we don't want traffic costs to spike.

Ben: for alerts — I'm going to mute the trace-orphans-prefetcher monitor for 30m while we investigate, then we can tune the threshold based on recent baseline. Filing a short PR to update the monitor: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/trace-orphans-prefetcher

Marie: posted trace id and links: https://jaeger.internal/trace/pf-abc123 and logs at https://logs.redwood/prod/prefetcher/pod/prefetcher-xxxxx?query=pf-abc123

Aditya: thanks — I can see the `sampler` env var in the pod is `parentbased_always_on` but the collector configmap had an old `probabilistic: 0.01` entry. Looks like a config drift after the last rollout. I'll open a tiny infra PR to sync the collector config with the standardized sampler we use for background jobs.

Marie: perfect. If you want, assign me the infra PR and I can validate in staging before prod roll. :thumbsup:

Rachel: FYI — once sampler is fixed, re-run the failing job for a couple of traces to confirm DB/KV spans reappear. If still missing, check our gRPC interceptor: services/shared/grpc/interceptor.go — it must forward context via `metadata.FromIncomingContext` -> `metadata.NewOutgoingContext`.

Ben: PR linked for mute + monitor tweak: https://monitoring.redwood/changes/3456. Will revert mute after fix or extend if needed.

Marie: thanks everyone — will follow up with a tiny change to init order in prefetcher and post back here when done.

Aditya: cool, ping me when you have the PR. I can help with the collector config review.

oncall-bot: [update] monitor trace-orphans-prefetcher muted by Ben for 30m

Marie: will do — closing loop once verified.
